channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Japanese Yen moves little after reaching six-week lows
item.description: USD/JPY remains flat after two days of gains, trading around 160.50 during the Asian hours. The pair moves little after reaching a six-week high of 160.56 during earlier hours on Thursday, which could be attributed to possible foreign-exchange intervention by Japanese authorities.

item.title: Gold steadies above YTD low on softer USD; bearish bias remains amid Fed hike bets
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) fades a modest Asian session bounce to the $4,118 region, though it manages to hold above the lowest level since November 2025 set earlier this Thursday.

item.title: Swiss Franc strengthens as US Dollar struggles despite increased risk aversion
item.description: USD/CHF depreciates after four days of gains, trading around 0.7990 during the Asian hours on Thursday. However, the downside of the pair could be restrained as the US Dollar (USD) may regain its ground amid rising safe-haven demand due to ongoing Middle East conflict.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Downward-sloping 20-day EMA reflects bearish tone, ECB policy awaited
item.description: The EUR/USD pair trades slightly higher to near 1.1550 during the Asian trading session on Thursday. The major currency pair edges higher as the Euro (EUR) gains ahead of the European Central Bank’s (ECB) monetary policy announcement at 12:15 GMT.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Rises to near 185.50 due to bullish emergence
item.description: EUR/JPY gains ground for the fourth successive day, trading around 185.30 during the Asian hours on Thursday. The EUR/JPY cross is holding a constructive bias, with spot remaining above the nine-day and 50-day Exponential Moving Averages (EMAs).

item.title: Israel's Home Front Command issues warning after attacks from Lebanon
item.description: Israeli military says during the Asian trading session on Thursday that the Home Front Command, the branch of the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) responsible for civil defense, issues an early warning after launches from Lebanon toward northern Israel.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar edges higher despite Iran conflict risks
item.description: The NZD/USD pair gains traction to around 0.5800 during the Asian trading hours on Thursday. Nonetheless, escalating tensions in the Middle East could weigh on the New Zealand Dollar (NZD) as a riskier asset against the US Dollar (USD). The US Producer Price Index (PPI) report.

item.title: Iran launches fresh missile barrage at Jordan, Kuwait and Bahrain
item.description: Bahrain, Jordan and Kuwait reportedly intercepted Iranian missiles and drones aimed at US military facilities on Thursday, signaling wider regional involvement in the conflict, Reuters reported.

item.title: Australian Dollar bounces off two-month low amid softer USD; upside seems capped
item.description: The AUD/USD pair recovers a few pips after touching a fresh two-month low during the Asian session on Thursday and moves back above the 0.7000 psychological mark.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD trades around $64.00 after rebounding from 11-week lows
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) gains ground after two days of losses, trading around $64.00 per troy ounce during the Asian hours.

item.title: British Pound nudges higher above 1.3350 despite rising Fed hike bets
item.description: The GBP/USD pair gathers strength to around 1.3385 during the Asian trading hours on Thursday. However, the potential upside might be limited amid rising expectations for higher-for-longer US interest rates.

item.title: Canadian Dollar remains on the front foot vs softer USD; upside potential seems limited
item.description: The USD/CAD pair struggles to capitalize on the overnight bounce from the 1.3900 mark, or the weekly low, and ticks lower during the Asian session on Thursday.

item.title: United States Dollar Index declines despite increased safe-haven demand
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is holding losses after registering minor gains in the previous day and trading around 100.00 during the Asian hours on Thursday.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.8150 vs. 6.8130 previous
item.description: The People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead on Thursday at 6.8150 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.8130 and 6.7819 Reuters estimate.

item.title: Euro gathers strength to near 1.1550 ahead of ECB rate decision
item.description: The EUR/USD pair trades in positive territory near 1.1540 during the early Asian trading hours on Thursday. Rising bets that the European Central Bank (ECB) will deliver a rate hike at its June policy meeting later on Thursday underpin the Euro (EUR) against the Greenback.

item.title: WTI rises to near $91.00 as US strikes continue against Iran
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price extends gains for the second successive day, trading around $90.70 per barrel during the Asian hours on Thursday.

item.title: US launches fresh strikes on Iran, IRGC closes Hormuz to all vessels
item.description: "Ending soon" did not survive the day.

item.title: Breaking: Japanese Yen hits 6-week low near 160.50 amid intervention fears
item.description: The USD/JPY pair edges higher to around 160.55 during the early Asian session on Thursday. The Japanese Yen (JPY) weakens to a near six-week low against the US Dollar (USD) after a hot US inflation report fuels expectations for higher-for-longer US Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rates.

item.title: US military launches strikes on ‘multiple targets’ in Iran after Trump vows to 'hit them hard’
item.description: The US Central Command (CENTCOM) said it began "additional self-defense strikes" on Wednesday against "multiple targets in Iran,” the Guardian reported. The US military added, "The strikes are in response to Iran's unwarranted and continued aggression.”

item.title: New Zealand's Kiwi is promising the most hikes and shown the least respect
item.description: The New Zealand Dollar is carrying the steepest implied tightening path in the developed world and trading like a currency nobody told.

item.title: The Australian Dollar is long the commodity and short the customer
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) has everything a currency bull could ask for except a functioning customer, and Wednesday made that distinction expensive.

item.title: Gold falls to multi‑month low below $4,050 as hot US inflation boosts Fed hawkish bets
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) tumbles to around $4,050, the lowest since November 2025, during the early Asian session on Thursday.

item.title: The British Pound Sterling is hawkish for all the wrong reasons
item.description: Pound Sterling was handed a gift on Wednesday and dropped it within the hour.

item.title: Japanese Yen drags a historic rate hike into intervention country
item.description: The Japanese Yen just logged its weakest close in nearly two years on the same day US inflation printed a fresh cycle high, and the most interesting part of the session is what did not happen.

item.title: Forex Today: US Dollar rebounds after inflation data
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY) trades with a firmer tone above 100.00 after May inflation data highlighted persistent price pressure in the United States (US). The headline Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 4.2% YoY, accelerating from 3.8% previously, while it increased 0.5% on a monthly basis.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD breaks below 200-day SMA, eyes on YTD low
item.description: Silver price drops below $65.00, extending its week-long losses to more than 6%, trading down nearly 2.50% in the day as the white metal breaks below the 200-day Simple Moving Average (SMA) at $67.25.

item.title: Euro trades muted ahead of expected ECB rate hike
item.description: The EUR/USD pair trades near the 1.1550 region on Thursday as the Euro (EUR) remains little changed despite expectations that the European Central Bank (ECB) will raise interest rates at its upcoming policy meeting.

item.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: US Dollar holds above 160 as RSI nears overbought, BoJ risk looms
item.description: The USD/JPY pair extends its gains for the second straight day on Wednesday, drifting higher above the 160.00 threshold, in an intervention zone.

item.title: Swiss Franc eases as traders weigh US inflation data and geopolitical risks
item.description: The Swiss Franc (CHF) weakens against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday as renewed tensions between the United States and Iran support demand for the Greenback, while traders show a muted reaction to the latest US inflation data.

item.title: “More than 100 million barrels of Oil moved through Strait of Hormuz”: US President Trump briefs on Hormuz
item.description: United States (US) President Donald Trump said on Tuesday that a secret US military operation helped secure commercial shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, allowing more than 100 million barrels of Oil to reach global markets amid ongoing tensions involving Iran.
